model: Each .cloud drifts horizontally, independent of scroll, and wraps edge-to-edge. Position x is relative to the left:50% center origin; transform is translate3d(x,0,0) scaleX(sx) scaleY(sy) where sx/sy are the cloud's base CSS scale (preserving flips).

params.speed_px_per_s: base = MIN_SPEED(8) + depth*(MAX_SPEED(22)-MIN_SPEED), depth = zIndex/maxZ; jitter = ±15%
params.wrap_span_px: halfViewport + cloudWidth; x wraps from +span to -span (and vice versa)

invariants.depth_ordering: nearer (higher z-index) clouds accumulate more distance per unit time
